fields.value: Code for A Structural Microsimulation Model for Demand-Side Cost-Sharing in Healthcare

dsDescriptionValue.value:
We model health expenditure distributions for age-gender categories. The analysis is based on individual level expenditure data that is not freely available and hence which we cannot publish. But the data is accessible to researchers via Vektis (https://www.vektis.nl/).

This repository contains the latest version of the paper, the code we use in the analysis and the files with the posterior samples of our Bayesian analysis.

publicationCitation.value: Boone, J., & Remmerswaal, M. (2024). A structural microsimulation model for demand-side cost-sharing in healthcare. Journal of Health Economics, 97, Article 102900.
